m.chalisa.do1: Śrī Rādhā, daughter of Vṛṣabhānu, support of your devotees' lives, you who roam the forest of Vṛndā, I bow to you again and again.
m.chalisa.do2: Beloved of Kṛṣṇa, abode of joy, such as I am, I am yours. Beautiful, joy-giving and lovely one, give me the refuge of your feet.
m.chalisa.cau1: Victory to Śrī Śyāmā, Vṛṣabhānu's princess; you are Kīrti's daughter and the abode of beauty.
m.chalisa.cau2: You sport eternally; you are Śyāma's support and the giver of boundless joy and blessing.
m.chalisa.cau3: You delight in the rāsa and spread its joy; you please the hearts of your lovely band of companions.
m.chalisa.cau4: You are Rādhā, ever young and fair; you are the treasure of Śyāma's life, and most simple at heart.
m.chalisa.cau5: You are an ocean of compassion, and your heart brims with joy; you are the companion of Lalitā and your other friends.
m.chalisa.cau6: You roam the banks of the Yamunā, the Sun's daughter; dear as life to Kṛṣṇa, you gladden his heart.
m.chalisa.cau7: Śyāma ever sings your virtues and rejoices, saying Rādhā, Rādhā.
m.chalisa.cau8: On his flute he always calls your name, and for your sake he takes on a body for his divine play.
m.chalisa.cau9: You are love itself in form, most delicate, Śyāma's beloved and Vṛṣabhānu's darling daughter.
m.chalisa.cau10: Young and ever fresh, you are the home of surpassing beauty; beside your radiance millions of Ratis and Kāmas look small.
m.chalisa.cau11: Your limbs are fair, and your face puts the moon to shame; your lovely eyes are restless and keen.
m.chalisa.cau12: Your two lotus feet are tinted with red lac; the sound of your anklets steals your beloved's heart.
m.chalisa.cau13: Your companions serve you constantly and fill their hearts with great joy and blessing.
m.chalisa.cau14: You are the life of those who relish divine love and the support of their very breath; the name Rādhā is the essence of every joy.
m.chalisa.cau15: You are unfathomable, beyond the senses and eternal in form; the king of Braj meditates on you night and day.
m.chalisa.cau16: Mine of virtues, from a portion of you arose countless Umās, Ramās and Brahmāṇīs.
m.chalisa.cau17: You sport in Goloka, the eternal abode; you protect your devotees and destroy sorrow and fault.
m.chalisa.cau18: Śiva, Brahmā, the sages Sanaka and his brothers, Nārada, Śeṣa and Sarasvatī cannot reach the end of you.
m.chalisa.cau19: Gazing at Rādhā's auspicious virtues and radiant form, Banavārī is delighted.
m.chalisa.cau20: Queen Rādhā is the life and treasure of Braj; her boundless glory cannot be told.
m.chalisa.cau21: With her arm around her beloved's neck, she roams Vṛndāvana for ever.
m.chalisa.cau22: Rādhā says Kṛṣṇa, and Kṛṣṇa says Rādhā; the two are one form, and their love is unfathomable.
m.chalisa.cau23: Śrī Rādhā steals the heart of Mohana, the enchanter; she gives joy to her devotees, and her face is in bloom.
m.chalisa.cau24: Nanda's son takes on millions of forms, the moon of Gokula, to behold you.
m.chalisa.cau25: He delights you with the play of the rāsa; when you turn away in pique, he is deeply grieved.
m.chalisa.cau26: When he gains sight of you, he is overjoyed, and he ever makes his entreaties to you in many ways.
m.chalisa.cau27: Śyāmā, who roam the forest of Vṛndā, taking your name fulfils every wish.
m.chalisa.cau28: You may perform millions of sacrifices and austerities, and keep many rules and vows in your heart,
m.chalisa.cau29: yet Śyāma does not take a devotee as his own until he sings the name of Rādhā.
m.chalisa.cau30: Rādhā is the mistress of the forest of Vṛndā; your form of divine play is boundless and unfathomable.
m.chalisa.cau31: Kṛṣṇa himself cannot find the end of you; who else could know you?
m.chalisa.cau32: Śrī Rādhā is one with rasa and love; the Vedas ever sing of her with reverence.
m.chalisa.cau33: Those who forsake Rādhā and worship Kṛṣṇa will not cross the ocean of the world even in a dream.
m.chalisa.cau34: When Rādhā, Kīrti's darling daughter, is remembered, every trouble of worldly existence vanishes.
m.chalisa.cau35: Her name destroys inauspiciousness at the root, takes away the three afflictions and is dear to the heart of Hari.
m.chalisa.cau36: If anyone takes the name of Rādhā, Dāmodara easily comes under his sway.
m.chalisa.cau37: The name of Rādhā gives the highest joy; as soon as one worships with it, the king of the Yadus shows his grace.
m.chalisa.cau38: Yaśodā's son will follow behind whoever remembers the name of Rādhā.
m.chalisa.cau39: Dear Śyāmā, who delight in the rāsa, lady of Barsānā, show your grace.
m.chalisa.cau40: Vṛndāvana is your refuge. Victory, victory, victory to Vṛṣabhānu's darling daughter.
m.chalisa.do3: Śrī Rādhā is sovereign of all, and Ghanaśyāma, dark as a rain-cloud, is lord of those who relish divine love; may I dwell for ever in the holy abode of Vṛndāvana.
